beats.test: How dominant is Drake's catalog in daily streaming right now?
beats.scriptSays: One rapper's catalog gets played on Spotify seven hundred times a second, and by the time the day closes out, that comes to fifty-nine million plays. beats.test: Can an artist dominate both as a lead artist and as a feature?
beats.scriptSays: Some carry their own records, like Post Malone with forty-nine billion streams on his own songs but only six billion as a guest. XXXTentacion has thirty-five billion on his own songs and six billion as a guest, while Kendrick has forty-one billion on his own songs and sixteen billion as a guest. Other rappers do more of their work on other people's records. Ty Dolla $ign has five billion streams on his own records but twenty-two billion as a feature. Young Thug has eleven billion on his own but twenty-one billion as a feature, while 21 Savage has sixteen billion on his own and twenty-three billion as a feature.
